contents_tesim: The second part of the Euthalian material belongs to the so-called chapter of testimonies, i.e., the register of quotations from Old Testament texts and other sources within Paul’s Epistles; cf. SIBE 2/3, I-1 to I-8
full_text_tesim: References to Sin. geo. NF 13 added to show the original sequence

The same original manuscript also contained the fragments from the Euthalian prologue from the UTO of the Pauline Epistles with Euthalian apparatus in Sinai Georgian NF M 55, as well as the UTOs of Hebrews and Philemon from Sinai Georgian NF M 13

The second part of the Euthalian material belongs to the so-called chapter of testimonies, i.e., the register of quotations from Old Testament texts and other sources within Paul’s Epistles; cf. SIBE 2/3, I-1 to I-8
